areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Only a single product on productive inclusion of women alongside other groups; resources small and aggregated, indicator weak, other dimensions of the area not covered.

areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: Not central to the programme; one aggregated inclusion product and a better indicator, but limited resources and no cultural or rights dimension.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Significant alignment and SMART indicators, but components and resource allocation do not prioritize environmental conservation; a limited share of resources.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Strong alignment through resilient farming systems and rural roads, with a component taking a significant resource share; targets imply moderate impact.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: High adherence across all final components, well-structured SMART indicators and relevant resources; coverage of target farmers is moderate.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Aligned and has a dedicated research component, but the indicator cannot capture science and technology results, so impact could not be measured (N/A).

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Only a mention of efficient irrigation; no clear strategic focus on water security and no aligned components, products or indicators (N/A).

bonus.reason: Proponent claimed most resources go to two federal priorities (deforestation and climate); rule requires all resources, so its own statement defeats the request.
Proponent did not state the programme promotes regional integration.
